title: X402 Music — Ship music like you ship code
excerpt: Pre-cleared tracks and stems, vector search, signed licenses, and credit billing — one API for agents and apps.
content_html:
Machine-native music infrastructure

Ship music
like you ship code.

Pre-cleared tracks and stems, vector discovery, signed commercial licenses and credit billing — one API built for agents and apps.

240

Tracks

960+

Stems

30

Genres

$0.20

From / license

Built for autonomous software

One call from idea to cleared audio.

No GPU queue, no email contracts, no per-seat seats. Every asset is deterministic, searchable and licensable by a machine.

≋

Instant stems

Stream drums, bass, melody, vocals or FX as chunked WAV. Mix in your own pipeline.

⌕

Vector discovery

Query by BPM, key, mood tags or an 8-dim emotion vector. Sub-100ms lookups.

✍

Signed licenses

Every commercial use gets a tamper-proof HMAC receipt you can verify offline.

◈

Credit billing

Prepaid credits, per-stem metering and Stripe Checkout. No subscription required.

⚡

Agent-ready auth

JWT or long-lived API key, OpenAPI 3.1 and an agent card. 60 req/min safety cap.

◉

Live catalog

240 tracks across 30 genres, with fee schedules and sentiment vectors exposed as JSON.

How it works

Three calls to a commercial license.

Mint a key

POST your name to /auth/register and receive a one-time API key plus a JWT.

Find the sound

Search by BPM, key or vibe vector, or page the catalog with genre and mood filters.

License + stream

Lock a track for a commercial term, get a signed receipt, then stream its stems.

# 1. mint
curl -s -X POST https://levievans.cloud/api/v1/auth/register \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"my-agent"}'

# 2. discover
curl -s 'https://levievans.cloud/api/v1/search?min_bpm=120&max_bpm=128&key=Amin' \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

# 3. license + stream
curl -s -X POST https://levievans.cloud/api/v1/license \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"client_wallet":"0xabc","track_ids":["trk_neon_drive"]}'

curl -s 'https://levievans.cloud/api/v1/stems/trk_neon_drive?stem=drums' \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o drums.wav

Pricing

Credits in. Audio out.

1 credit = 1 US cent. Streams cost 1 credit per stem request; licenses use each track’s fee. Buy a pack, spend it across any endpoint.

Get access

Mint a key in one request.

Self-serve. The API key is shown once — store it server-side, never in a browser bundle or repo.
